tools.name: register_tools
tools.description: Register a tool list once and get a set_id for route_tools. Pass "tools" (array in MCP, OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini or Bedrock form, max 500) or "url" (public remote MCP server; its tools are listed, never called). Same tools always get the same set_id; sets are kept 90 days after last use. Free.

tools.name: route_tools
tools.description: Which of my tools does this task need? Send "set_id" (from register_tools) or "tools", plus "query" (the task). Returns a ranked shortlist (adaptive 3-12 tools, or "k"), confidence (high/medium/low/none), matched terms, token savings and the definitions ready to inject ("format": mcp, openai, anthro

findings.title: Description uses pressure/override language
findings.detail: Description of "register_tools" stacks urgency/override words (always, never). Legitimate tool descriptions rarely pressure the model to act or ignore prior guidance.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: register_tools · Private data: route_tools · Public sink: route_tools · Destructive: route_tools.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: register_tools · Private data: route_tools · Public sink: route_tools · Destructive: route_tools

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
